case_plan.identity: Exactly the same 199-case generator as research/fresh_challenger_formal_validation.py; no case generation changes are authorized.
case_plan.original_pools: Every pool in research/catalog.json, with union explicitly equal to the full 34-name frozen universe.
case_plan.joint_optical_leader_removal: Full frozen universe excluding sz300308, sz300502, sz300394.
case_plan.single_name_only: One case for each of the 34 frozen symbols.
case_plan.leave_one_out: One case for each of the 34 frozen symbols removed from the full universe.
case_plan.sector_removal: One case for each sector in the frozen catalog.
case_plan.deterministic_subsets: Using numpy default_rng(seed=34), six fixed samples for each size 2,3,5,8,13,22,26,33.
case_plan.common_five_exhaustive: All 31 nonempty subsets of the frozen common-five pool.
case_plan.cardinality_coverage: Using default_rng(seed=35), one fixed sample for every size 2..33 not already in the deterministic-subset size set.
case_plan.prefix: Exact candidate and control equality between the full frozen snapshot and prefix cut at historical index 500 for union.
case_plan.candidate_parameter_stability: NOT_APPLICABLE_NUMERIC_GRID: the candidate adds no tunable numeric strategy parameter.

policies.equal_weight: Additional benchmark for every original catalog pool.
